name: commonhours
description: CommonHours — community service exchange with time credits, trust paths and attestation.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,green "npm run dev -w @commonhours/api" "npm run dev -w @commonhours/web"
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.test: npm run test -w @commonhours/api && npm run test -w @commonhours/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @commonhours/shared && npm run typecheck -w @commonhours/api && npm run typecheck -w @commonhours/web
